properties.source: NOAA NCEI IBTrACS v04r01 (public domain), North Atlantic basin hurricane-strength fixes (>= 64 kt), seasons 1971-2020: 6-hourly fixes binned on a 2.5 deg grid, 1-2-1 smoothed, outer contour at 15% of peak density, closed and simplified by script. A climatological track-density envelope, not any single storm.
